summary: v2 regression + new feature testing. Backend: 11/13 pytest cases pass; the 2 failures are pre-existing flaky tests in test_gyro_repeater.py (simulator emits HDT rounded to 1 decimal so heading walk can produce identical .1f values, and custom $HEHDT reflection race with 10Hz simulator). New v2 tests all pass: WebSocket payload includes rot/cog/sog (numeric); custom $HEROT,-12.5 and $HEVTG,091.2,T,,M,10.3,N,,K burst-sent via UDP are correctly parsed and reflected on the WS stream; malformed / bad-checksum / short ROT+VTG sentences are silently ignored; simulator ROT stays within ±30°/min. Frontend: SIM badge visible, LIVE status green, COG/SOG populated (e.g. 281.3° / 13.5 kn), ROT indicator streams values with sign→side/color mapping working (both PORT [#EF4444 red] and STBD [#10B981 green] observed in the bar), heading history chart polyline renders after data collection (138 points), bearing reset (R) works, settings dialog opens, NMEA feed shows $HEVTG sentences. Compass card rotates so the current heading aligns with the top lubber line.

minor.issue: Flaky. Simulator sends HDT with %.1f rounding + very small ±0.03°/tick random walk => two /api/health polls 2s apart can return identical rounded heading. Test should tolerate this or poll longer.
Flaky. Simulator now emits 3 sentences per tick (HDT+ROT+VTG); custom $HEHDT,123.4 burst races with sim overwrite. Consider widening tolerance or increasing burst count.

ui_bugs.issue: Auto-scale legend hardcoded: renders '±5° auto' regardless of actual deviation. Code: `±${Math.max(5, 0).toFixed(0)}° auto` — should use the computed maxDev value.

action_items: Optional: fix HeadingChart legend to display actual auto-scale range (use maxDev instead of Math.max(5,0)).
Optional: loosen the two flaky legacy tests in test_gyro_repeater.py (heading walk & custom-HDT reflection) so they don't race with simulator.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py simulator_loop cog computation adds fixed 2.5° offset from heading — realistic but note cog & heading are highly correlated in sim (fine for a repeater display test).
HeadingChart legend text is hardcoded '±5° auto' — visible bug (still reads 5 no matter the scale). Purely cosmetic.

useHeadingStream stores history in a ref (historyRef.current) which by itself wouldn't cause React re-renders; it works only because parent App re-renders whenever cog/sog/rot state updates. If those state updates were ever throttled, chart would stop updating. Consider tying chart update to a state tick.
parse_vtg accepts field 5 (SOG knots) but doesn't verify field 6 == 'N'. Minor spec-tightness issue; not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New v2 backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_rot_vtg.py — they open a WS then burst-send $HEROT/$HEVTG to 127.0.0.1:4001 and poll frames until custom values appear. The two failing legacy tests in test_gyro_repeater.py are flaky by design (simulator races) — not v2 regressions. HeadingChart legend has a harmless hardcoded '±5° auto' label.
rca of the issue: HeadingChart.jsx line ~40: `±${Math.max(5, 0).toFixed(0)}° auto` — the intended `maxDev` variable is not in scope at that point (it's computed inside the `if (has)` branch). Fix: hoist maxDev outside the branch, or move the legend into the branch.
